controls.reason: The bound control registry is finite and the status field has exactly four allowed values, so completeness and enumeration validity are fully decidable.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing row, duplicate row, empty status, or any fifth status cannot pass the exact registry join and enum check; no judgment is needed.

controls.reason: Applicability and accountable ownership require human authority, while rerunning one declared recipe does not prove that evidence is generally current or reproducible.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A control can be wrongly marked not applicable, name a nominal owner, and have a recipe repeat one cached result while the underlying evidence cannot be reproduced from source inputs. Both clauses pass but the rule is unmet.

controls.reason: The rule requires exact evidence bindings, and each named product, revision, digest, version, environment, data-state, and date field has objective referential checks.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Omitting or misbinding any named identifier fails or blocks; identical sealed records and referenced artifacts always produce the same result.

controls.reason: Schema fields and expiry state do not establish genuine risk ownership, effective monitoring, or adequate documentation for the exception.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An exception can name an inactive owner and a dashboard that never alerts, yet contain all fields and expire automatically. The proposal passes while the exception is not risk-owned or monitored.

controls.reason: A registry entry cannot prove that supplier-operated controls remain substantively assessed or that the named internal person has accepted non-outsourced accountability.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A supplier control can remain as a placeholder row with an inactive employee as owner while nobody internally can answer for it. The clause passes but accountability was outsourced in practice.

controls.reason: The versioned checklist corpus and assessment registry form finite identifier sets, so exact set equality detects every omitted checklist item.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Any missing, duplicated, or extra identifier prevents Pass, and omission cannot be disguised as a status.

controls.reason: The permitted statuses are a closed four-value enumeration, making every status mechanically valid or invalid.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Pass, Fail, Blocked, and Not Applicable pass; misspellings, custom states, and empty values fail deterministically.

controls.reason: Whether an override is authorized is an accountable approval decision; an authenticated record proves authorship but not legitimate authority or judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A signed override from a user incorrectly granted an approver role can let Blocked pass. The record is authenticated, yet no genuinely authorized decision exists.

controls.reason: Applicability and accountable ownership are governance judgments, so exact-one identity cardinality cannot prove the whole assignment requirement.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A material control can be marked not applicable or assigned to a directory identity that never accepted responsibility. Cardinality passes while no accountable owner exists.

controls.reason: Each required evidence context is an exact identifier or version binding, and referential integrity can be checked against sealed artifacts and records.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A stale flag state, different digest, missing dependency version, or mismatched environment cannot pass the full binding comparison.

controls.reason: Nonempty sampling fields do not prove that the population, method, confidence, limitations, and risk rationale are meaningful or internally coherent.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A record can write unknown for population and acceptable for rationale while filling every field. The schema passes although the sampling basis is not documented usefully.

controls.reason: Declared absence conditions and selected tests may omit conditions in which the primary control is actually absent, and working is not given a complete effect oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A compensating rate limit can pass when the firewall is disabled in one fixture but fail during distributed bursts or a second bypass path. Every declared test passes while the control does not work under all required conditions.

controls.reason: Inherent and residual risk are distinct release-bound fields, so presence and linkage after the recorded controls are objectively checkable.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A record containing only inherent risk, swapping the fields, or lacking linked controls fails; the rule does not require judging whether the risk estimate is wise.

controls.reason: The aggregate gate has a precise invariant: any critical failure must force failure regardless of unrelated scores, which can be exhaustively evaluated over the decision function.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A scoring path that lets passes offset one critical failure produces a failing fixture; compliant paths cannot be changed by unrelated scores.

controls.reason: Versioned severity definitions and immutable timestamps make it decidable whether blocking policy existed before any assessment result.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A policy created or changed after results cannot pass the timestamp and version binding check.

controls.reason: Immutable assessment versions linked to immutable release identities make overwrite and historical-release binding objective artifact properties.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Deleting, replacing, or repointing a historical assessment breaks its digest or append-only chain and cannot pass verification.

controls.reason: Control identity and complete text have an authoritative corpus revision, permitting exact byte-normalized comparison.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A shortened, altered, stale, or mismatched control text fails the corpus comparison without interpretation.

controls.reason: Assessment status is a required closed-enum record field, so its presence and value are fully bounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Missing and invalid statuses fail; exactly one allowed status passes.

controls.reason: A nonempty string does not establish that the text is a real applicability rationale tied to the control and product context.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The value because can satisfy nonempty validation while explaining nothing about applicability. The clause passes but no rationale has been provided.

controls.reason: A resolvable identity proves directory existence, not that the person has authority, accepted responsibility, or is accountable for the control.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An inactive employee or unrelated executive can be entered in the owner field and resolve successfully while no accountable owner exists.

controls.reason: The minimum-record requirement is limited to a resolvable implementing identity or team, which is an objective directory reference fact.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing, deleted, or malformed team reference fails; the control does not ask the checker to judge implementation quality.

controls.reason: Authentication proves who signed, but qualified reviewer status and valid approval require an authorized human-governance decision not defined by mere fields.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A signed approval from an unqualified reviewer can satisfy presence and signature checks while the required qualified review never occurred.

controls.reason: A resolvable evidence location and allowed access-classification enum are exact record properties with bounded validation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Broken references, missing classifications, and unknown values fail; valid bound references pass.

controls.reason: Evidence and expiry timestamps have objective syntax, ordering, and policy-freshness checks.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An absent date, expiry before evidence creation, or expired record cannot pass.

controls.reason: The named system, component, environment, revision, digest, configuration, schema, flag, and dependency fields are exact evidence-context bindings.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Any absent or conflicting context identifier fails referential validation; no qualitative claim is inferred.

controls.reason: The minimum evidence schema explicitly requires method, data, tools, versions, assumptions, and limitations, making complete field presence and bindings bounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing tool version or absent limitations field fails; adequacy of the test is evaluated by other controls.

controls.reason: Observed result and threshold are typed required fields whose units, value types, and evaluation relationship can be validated exactly.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Missing, incompatible, or unevaluable result-threshold pairs cannot pass.

controls.reason: The requirement is a bounded reference field: valid linked issue identities or an explicit none state can be checked exactly.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Dangling links, unknown issue types, and absent explicit state fail deterministically.

controls.reason: A versioned reassessment-trigger definition is a concrete required record artifact with a fixed schema.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Missing, malformed, or unversioned trigger definitions fail; the rule does not claim the chosen trigger is optimal.

controls.reason: Exact control identity is bounded, but a nonempty string does not prove that it explains why remediation is not complete.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An exception can use pending as its entire explanation and pass the field check while failing to identify the actual remediation gap.

controls.reason: Existing and proposed compensating-control collections with resolvable identifiers are exact exception-record requirements.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing collection, dangling identifier, or failure to distinguish existing from proposed controls cannot pass.

controls.reason: Successful results under declared conditions do not prove that compensating controls work across every accepted-risk condition without a complete protocol and oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A cache-based control can pass the one declared outage test while failing during a relevant regional partition omitted from the exception conditions. Evidence is current but demonstration remains incomplete.

controls.reason: Typed queries and thresholds do not prove they are specific or adequate for the accepted risk; relevance and useful alert limits require risk judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An exception for data loss can monitor CPU at 100 percent with a syntactically valid threshold and route. All fields pass while the accepted risk is not monitored.

controls.reason: References and dates do not prove real remediation ownership or that a plan is funded and executable.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A nonexistent budget document can be referenced, an inactive person named, and future timestamps supplied. The record passes while no funded remediation plan exists.

controls.reason: At least one machine-readable predicate does not prove that the necessary immediate revocation conditions have been identified.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An exception can revoke only on February 30, a never-true predicate, while omitting an actual breach trigger. The clause passes but the exception has no effective revocation conditions.

controls.reason: Automatic expiry is bounded, but valid renewal authority and whether an exception has become permanent architecture require accountable contextual judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A sequence of newly signed one-day exceptions can renew forever and remain technically separate. Both clauses pass while the exception has become permanent architecture in practice.

controls.reason: Material quality objectives and adequate budgets or regression limits require product-specific judgment not supplied by timestamped records.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A team can define a budget only for a trivial metric before implementation while omitting a material reliability objective. The record passes but quality budgets are incomplete.

controls.reason: Registered objectives and conflicts may omit real conflicts, and an identity field does not prove accountable ownership.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An unregistered security-versus-usability conflict has no owner while every recorded conflict names a nominal account. Cardinality passes though the rule is unmet.

controls.reason: Resolvable links do not establish meaningful traceability between a quality objective and the tactics, code, tests, monitoring, or decisions that realize it.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A latency objective can link to unrelated source files and a generic dashboard. Every required edge exists, but the graph does not trace how the objective is implemented or verified.

controls.reason: Measurements under selected conditions do not prove the full performance behavior unless duration, sampling, workload coverage, and statistical oracle are complete.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A short test can meet all four thresholds while a longer expected workload exposes a resource leak. Current measurements pass, yet completion time and throughput fail under another relevant specified condition.

controls.reason: One bounded result per declared boundary cannot prove true capacity limits or safe behavior across overload shapes, duration, dependencies, and recovery.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A service can reject load safely at the tested rate while corrupting queued data during a longer overload. Declared tests pass but safe overload behavior is not demonstrated.

controls.reason: Declared exchange invariants and bounded cases cannot exhaust input values, ordering, identities, authorization contexts, and privacy leakage paths.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Contract fixtures can preserve every field for one message while a retry reorders events or another tenant leaks data. All declared tests pass although information exchange violates the broad rule.

controls.reason: A successful result for each support-matrix cell does not define which promised behaviors must be exercised within that cell.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every browser-version cell can pass a page-load test while file upload fails in one supported browser. The matrix is green, yet clients do not interoperate as promised.

controls.reason: Versioned user-centric availability indicators, windows, and thresholds make authenticated telemetry comparison an exact retrospective property.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A measured window below objective fails, and a complete authoritative measurement at or above it passes; the checker does not extrapolate beyond the declared window.

controls.reason: Declared recovery exercises do not prove coverage of every relevant failure scenario, and integrity or continuity requires a complete state oracle.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A restore can meet time and point thresholds in one scenario while returning subtly corrupt data after a different failure. Every declared exercise passes although recovery objectives are not generally met.

controls.reason: The presence of a baseline disclaimer cannot prove that the rest of the document makes no universal-applicability claim without semantic review of all prose.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A document can contain the required disclaimer and elsewhere say every reference applies to every product, so phrase presence passes contradictory content.

controls.reason: Issuing-body metadata is authoritative for an edition, but the proposal does not establish a complete inventory of every audit, procurement, certification, or compliance claim.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Registered claims can cite the current edition while an unregistered sales compliance claim uses a superseded edition. Every checked row passes although the organization did not verify every claim.

controls.reason: Referenced documents form a finite corpus inventory and issuing-body publication status is authoritative, enabling exact enum comparison.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A draft labeled published or guidance labeled a standard conflicts with the issuer record and cannot pass.

controls.reason: A citation and digest do not prove that the text was lawfully obtained, authorized for use, or substantively used in the conformance assessment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A copied unauthorized edition can have the correct digest and reference while assessors never use it. Artifact checks pass although the authoritative text was not legitimately obtained and used.

controls.reason: Standards-clause applicability and semantic mapping to local controls, evidence, and exceptions require specialist interpretation; graph edges alone are not proof.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A privacy clause can link to an unrelated logging control and evidence file while all identifiers resolve. The record passes but the clause is not mapped to a control that satisfies its outcome.

controls.reason: Annual freshness is bounded, but the trigger ledger cannot prove it contains every new jurisdiction, product, data use, incident, contract, or standards revision.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The annual review can be current and every recorded event linked while a new jurisdiction is omitted from the ledger. Both clauses pass though the required triggered review never occurred.

controls.reason: An evidence link does not prove adequate evidence for security, privacy, accessibility, reliability, compatibility, or data-quality objectives.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every objective can link to a placeholder report or irrelevant test. Links are current and bound, but specialist and empirical evidence for the objectives is still absent.

controls.reason: Digest binding is objective, but production-representative configuration and adequate verification of the artifact-configuration pair are undefined qualitative claims.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A staging configuration can be labeled representative and a smoke test bound to the right digest. Both clauses pass although important production topology and settings were never verified.

controls.reason: Cryptographic artifact presence is bounded, but which approvals are required and whether they are valid accountable approvals is not proved by references alone.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The artifact can have valid provenance, SBOM, and signature while the only approval is from an unauthorized account or a required safety approval is omitted. The clause passes its manifest but the complete requirement is unmet.

controls.reason: Version fields for supplied delivery inputs do not prove a complete inventory, and authenticated review records do not establish valid accountable review.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All listed files can be versioned and signed off while an unlisted migration script changes production and was never reviewed. The proposed clause passes despite an unreviewed delivery input.

controls.reason: A successful result per plan scenario does not define complete fault conditions, data oracles, participants, and end-to-end outcomes for five broad practices.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each practice can pass one happy-path drill while reconciliation misses split duplicates or incident response fails outside office hours. Records exist but the practices are not adequately tested.

controls.reason: Explicit registers cannot prove that every known limitation, residual risk, exception, and deferred item has been disclosed rather than omitted or relabeled.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each register can exist and contain entries while a known critical limitation is left out. The clause passes because it validates collections, not completeness of organizational knowledge.

controls.reason: Existence and version binding do not prove release, migration, deprecation, or support information is complete, accurate, and prepared for its audience.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A release note containing only version 1.2 can exist and be bound while omitting a breaking migration. The artifact passes presence checks although required information is not prepared.

controls.reason: Temporary classification and accountable ownership require judgment, so identity and future-date fields do not prove the whole rule.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A temporary bypass can be labeled permanent and a nominal owner entered. Every declared temporary control has valid fields while the actual temporary control evades the check.

controls.reason: Links for retained records cannot prove that every relevant evidence item and decision was captured or that none was overwritten outside the retained set.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All stored records can link correctly while an adverse decision is deleted before ingestion. The surviving set passes, yet evidence and decisions were not fully retained.

controls.reason: The blocker register may omit or relabel blockers, and an authorized exception is not the same as resolving the blocker stated by the original rule.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every listed blocker can be resolved or waived while a suppressed blocker is absent. The clause passes even though not all release blockers are resolved.

controls.reason: Metadata and signatures do not prove reviewers are truly independent, qualified, or authorized to provide the required sign-off.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Two accounts controlled by the same implementer can satisfy identity-separation fields and sign every row. The matrix passes while independent review was not completed.

controls.reason: The rule is limited to defining post-deployment criteria, and typed checks, metrics, thresholds, and observation windows completely establish that plan record.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Absent metrics, thresholds, or window bounds fail; whether the release later meets them is a separate control.

controls.reason: Which journeys are critical is contextual, and one successful end-to-end result does not define complete roles, states, data, and failure-path coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A trivial login path can be listed and pass while account deletion is wrongly deemed noncritical or only its happy path is tested. Both clauses pass though a critical journey lacks successful evidence.

controls.reason: Applicability, reviewer independence, qualification, and verification adequacy cannot be proved by a structured completion record alone.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An implementer's second account can record independent verification of one happy-path authorization check while tenant isolation remains untested. The clause passes but independent verification is absent.

controls.reason: The proposal only covers recorded exposures and treats containment and investigation completion as fields, not accountable evidence that every exposure was addressed.
controls.counterexample_analysis: One token incident can show all completed states while an exposed personal-data export is never recorded or its investigation is rubber-stamped. Both clauses pass although exposure remains unaddressed.

controls.reason: Current exercises for declared paths do not establish exhaustive failure scenarios or complete integrity and continuity oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A rollback drill can meet its metrics on a small fixture while a regional disaster restore corrupts an untested data class. Every planned path passes but approved recovery objectives are not generally achievable.

controls.reason: Mapping and threshold comparisons cannot prove correctness, accessibility, security, privacy, or safety without complete empirical protocols and specialist authority.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A journey can meet numeric latency and automated scan thresholds while exposing private data or remaining unusable with assistive technology. All mapped evidence passes, yet critical objectives are unmet.

controls.reason: A provenance graph can verify digests, but it does not by itself prove complete dependencies, trusted build status, meaningful source review, tests, or authorized approval.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A signed chain can omit a dynamic build download and link to a checkbox review by an unauthorized actor. Verification passes while the production artifact lacks the complete trusted trace.

controls.reason: Append-only transitions cannot detect semantic relabeling outside the blocker identity, and authorized evidence-based risk acceptance requires accountable judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A blocker can be deleted and recreated as informational so no transition exists, or an irrelevant log can support a signed waiver. Records pass while a blocker was suppressed without valid acceptance.

controls.reason: The predeployment plan has six explicit threshold and action fields with measurable values, making the ability to state them an objective record property.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Missing, nonmeasurable, or post-deployment thresholds fail; operational wisdom of the chosen values is outside this control.

controls.reason: One directory identity per domain does not prove that the organization has assigned and recognized accountable authority for that domain.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A single uninformed executive can be listed for every domain and resolve in the directory while no one accepts operational or privacy accountability.

controls.reason: The final-package requirement names exact identifiers, digests, versions, and flag states whose presence and integrity bindings are mechanically checkable.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Any missing or malformed release field, stale version, or conflicting digest fails the package schema.

controls.reason: Artifact presence and release binding do not prove that scope, inventory, or diagrams are complete, accurate, and final.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A blank architecture diagram and partial asset list can be versioned and bound to the release. The manifest passes while the final scope and diagrams are substantively missing.

controls.reason: A package manifest cannot prove that data inventory, classifications, retention schedule, and privacy records are complete or legally correct.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A partial inventory can omit biometric data and still include all four named files. Presence passes while privacy and retention obligations for that data are absent.

controls.reason: Threat models, abuse cases, risk registers, and exception registers require substantive completeness; four file references prove only presence.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Placeholder documents can be bound to the release while omitting an obvious account-takeover threat. The package passes but the required assessments are not substantively present.

controls.reason: Identifying applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, privacy, accessibility, and security requirements requires specialist authority, not a versioned list alone.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The register can omit a newly applicable jurisdictional privacy duty while containing source versions for listed rules. The schema passes although applicable requirements are missing.

controls.reason: Resolvable graph edges do not establish that tests verify requirements or that evidence proves controls, and source inventories can be incomplete.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every requirement can link to a trivial smoke test and every control to an unrelated log. Identifiers resolve, but traceability is not meaningful.

controls.reason: Result-file presence does not prove valid applicability, adequate test coverage, or meaningful user acceptance across the six test classes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each class can have a one-line passing result for an empty fixture while core behavior is untested. The package is complete by manifest but lacks substantive test results.

controls.reason: Applicability and adequacy of browser, localization, usability, and accessibility results require user and specialist judgment beyond bound file presence.
controls.counterexample_analysis: One desktop browser result and an automated accessibility scan can satisfy selected classes while mobile usability and manual accessibility remain untested. Manifest checks pass but results are incomplete.

controls.reason: Release-bound performance result files do not prove that each named test type used adequate profiles, durations, environments, and outcome oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Six short smoke-load runs can create all named result artifacts while missing a memory leak and true capacity limit. Presence passes but substantive performance results are inadequate.

controls.reason: Scenario-bound result records do not establish complete dependency failures, recovery states, data integrity, and continuity oracles for the six broad classes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A single failover fixture can pass while a relevant region outage loses writes. All named result files exist, yet resilience and recovery evidence is incomplete.

controls.reason: Security artifact presence does not establish adequate scan scope, meaningful code review, threat validation, or penetration-test coverage.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A dependency scan and one-page penetration report can be current and bound while authorization paths are never reviewed or tested. The manifest passes without substantive security results.

controls.reason: SBOM, license report, provenance, signatures, and attestations are artifact-bound objects with exact digests, schemas, and cryptographic integrity checks.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing artifact, broken signature, mismatched digest, or unbound attestation cannot pass the verified package requirement.

controls.reason: Six current review records do not prove that infrastructure, network, DNS, certificates, secrets, and production configuration were reviewed adequately by authorized reviewers.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each record can be a signed checkbox with no scope or findings. The package passes while critical DNS and secret configuration remains unreviewed.

controls.reason: Evidence-file presence for plans does not prove successful restoration, disaster recovery, or continuity under complete scenarios and state oracles.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A backup log and one tiny restore exercise can populate every package entry while a full production restore fails. Manifest validation passes but recovery evidence is inadequate.

controls.reason: Named drill records do not prove realistic scenarios, qualified participants, escalation behavior, or successful communications outcomes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A tabletop with one participant can produce all five evidence labels while the on-call route and customer communication path fail in practice. Presence passes but the drills are not substantive.

controls.reason: Review-record presence cannot prove adequate monitoring, dashboard, synthetic, logging, audit, and telemetry coverage or valid reviewer conclusions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Six empty review forms can be current and source-bound while critical journeys have no telemetry. The manifest passes although the required review was not meaningfully performed.

controls.reason: Supplier applicability and adequate risk, contract, subprocessor, and continuity review require legal and accountable specialist judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every listed supplier can have four placeholder records while an important subprocessor clause is missed or an unlisted supplier is omitted. The package passes without valid third-party review.

controls.reason: The final-package requirement is limited to current versioned open-defect, risk, and exception registers, which are exact manifest and freshness facts.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing, stale, unversioned, or incorrectly bound register fails; closure quality is not claimed by this item.

controls.reason: Required fields do not prove a real accountable owner, meaningful impact, effective compensating control or monitoring, or funded remediation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: An exception can fill every field with nominal identities and irrelevant links. Schema validation passes while none of the safeguards is substantively valid.

controls.reason: Release-bound plan files do not prove deployment, recovery, and validation plans are complete, executable, or appropriate for the release.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Three placeholder documents can be versioned and bound while omitting database rollback. The package passes presence checks but the required plans are not prepared.

controls.reason: Authenticated records prove signatures, not that approvals and sign-offs were authorized or that the final decision rationale is meaningful.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Unauthorized accounts can sign every matrix row and the rationale can say approved. The package passes while required approval and reasoned final decision are absent.

controls.reason: Annual freshness is bounded, but recorded major revisions are not a complete authoritative inventory of all tracked-standard changes.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The corpus can have a recent annual review and link every recorded revision while a major issuer update is never entered. Both clauses pass though the required event review is missed.

controls.reason: The entry-event ledger cannot prove it includes every new jurisdiction, sector, population, deployment model, or contractual regime.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All recorded events can link to reviews while a new child-user population is omitted from the ledger. The clause passes although the corpus was not reviewed for that entry.

controls.reason: Tracked standards are a finite register and issuing-body records are authoritative for current publication status, allowing exact status comparison.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A withdrawn or draft standard mislabeled as published conflicts with the issuer and fails deterministically.

controls.reason: Published and draft status are authoritative enums, and a prior authenticated transition decision is the exact exception the rule permits.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Replacing a published baseline with a draft without an earlier decision fails; a properly recorded early-adoption decision satisfies the stated exception without judging its wisdom.

controls.reason: Content-addressed corpus versions and exact release or audit references make preservation and version use objective artifact properties.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A missing historical version, changed bytes, dangling reference, or multiple ambiguous versions cannot pass digest verification.

controls.reason: Corpus diffs detect changes, but a nonempty rationale and owner field do not prove a meaningful reason or accountable ownership.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every diff can link to rationale changed and a nominal identity. Coverage passes while the change lacks a real rationale and owner.

controls.reason: Links, headings, checklist syntax, front matter, encoding, and relative paths have bounded parsers over a sealed Markdown corpus.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Malformed syntax, broken bounded links, invalid encoding, and path escapes fail fixed validators; identical files always yield the same result.
